Mark Carney pushes idea of making Canada 'associate member' of EU, WSJ reports
articles.description: Canada seeks closer European Union ties, exploring associate membership status. This strategic pivot follows escalating trade disputes with the United States. Discussions involve free movement of goods, services, and workers in key sectors. Joint infrastructure projects for energy and data are also under consideration. Prime Minister Mark Carney will meet French President Emmanuel Macron soon.

articles.title: Mark Carney pitches Canada to global investors as Trump tries to pull investment south
articles.description: Canada is hosting a summit to attract global investment for its projects. Prime Minister Mark Carney aims to secure billions for Canadian industries. This event seeks to reduce economic reliance on the United States. Investors are attending to explore opportunities in critical minerals and technology. The summit highlights Canada's stable and rules-based investment environment.

articles.title: ‘Huge destructive power’: North Korea holds live-fire drill with missiles, artillery and drones
articles.description: In a show of military might, North Korea executed a comprehensive live-fire drill incorporating missiles, artillery, and drones, underscoring the devastating implications of combined firepower amid escalating regional tensions. South Korean defenses observed several short-range ballistic missiles launched from Wonsan. This operation followed a trilateral military exercise with the US, South Korea, and Japan, suggesting that Kim Jong Un may be positioning for more advantageous negotiations in the future.

articles.title: Manipur govt urges JFD to call off agitation over NRC and census, warns of public hardship
articles.description: Manipur government spokespersons Th. Radheshyam and Sapam Ranjan Singh have urged the JFD to withdraw its agitation demanding the closure of government offices over the NRC. The government said Manipur wants the NRC conducted before the Census, with 1951 as the base year, and warned that prolonged protests could disrupt government functioning and cause further inconvenience to the public.

articles.title: ‘Trump’s Worst Nightmare’: Mark Carney Dumps U.S. Trade Deal; Chooses America’s ‘Biggest’ Rival
articles.description: Mark Carney has sharpened his push to reduce Canada’s dependence on the United States, arguing that the country is “about so much more than being next to the United States” and touting new trade and investment opportunities abroad.The Canadian prime minister said Ottawa remains open to a deal with Washington, but only one that respects Canadian sovereignty. At the same time, Carney is pushing diversification beyond the U.S., promoting Canada as a global investment destination and signaling that Trump’s tariff pressure will not dictate Ottawa’s economic future.

articles.title: IRGC’s Big Counter-Terror Raid: 4 'US, Israel-Linked' Terrorists Killed Near Pakistan Border
articles.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says it has killed four alleged terrorists in a joint counter-terrorism operation in Saravan County, in southeastern Iran’s Sistan and Baluchestan Province. The IRGC says the group was planning targeted killings and that weapons, ammunition and explosives were recovered from its hideout. Three Iranian intelligence personnel were also killed in the operation. Iranian authorities have accused the U.S. and Israel of backing groups seeking to destabilize the region.
